description: A Docker-style build log retains the failing Dockerfile location.

files.docker-build:
for i in $(seq 1 75); do echo "#${i} [stage $i/75] RUN cached dependency"; done
echo 'ERROR: Dockerfile:17: failed to solve: COPY package-lock.json not found'
exit 1

prompt: Run 'sh docker-build --fake'. State the failing file and line number only.
